title: Where does the hook's judge file a mistake's missing guard to triage?
why: R67 express lane, 12:54 CST Nov 13: R16 says the judge files the missing guard to triage, but report_guard.py has no filing target.
note: Todo. Ruling R16 (owner 16:25 CST Nov 10): "the HOOK/judge files it not the session itself". No record names where triage reads it. Roadmap-branch writes belong to triage only (roadmap-one-writer), so a hook cannot push there. Options for the coordinator: a message to the triage session, the mailbox after the cutover (ruling mailbox-replaces-send-message), or a file under a path triage reads on each wake. A log needs a named reader (root CLAUDE.md): name triage.
